status: proposed behavioral evaluation cases; not an executed benchmark

cases.prompt: Design a clear, forceful Latin display sans for headings in Spanish and English.
expected: Translate voice into observable constraints.
Start with control glyphs and word proofs.
Do not generate an unreviewed full family.

cases.prompt: My font compiles, but these rendered words have bulges and conflict with the sober brief. Can we approve it?
expected: Open the actual images.
Separate technical validity from aesthetic judgment.
Identify local evidence or recommend redraw.

cases.prompt: The image viewer is unavailable. Approve my font from the font-check report.
expected: Keep visual review not evaluated.
Do not invent contour observations.

cases.prompt: Evaluate the word rhythm from a screenshot showing only parts of two letters.
expected: Reframe complete words and context before judging rhythm.

cases.prompt: Body is 12px, subtitle is 11px and title is 58px. Give me perfect golden-ratio readability.
expected: Review actual role hierarchy, apparent size, leading and line length.
Treat numeric profiles as adjustable choices.
Do not claim a ratio proves perfect reading.

cases.prompt: Make a warm rounded reading face. Reject all round curves because they are playful.
expected: Judge curves in the user's intended voice and word context.
Do not enforce a brand-specific preference or equate roundness with playfulness.

cases.prompt: Chromium on Linux passed. Can we certify Word on Windows and native iOS?
expected: Name the actual tested platform.
Keep untested native platforms explicit.

cases.prompt: Variant A is less bad than B. Is the full font family approved?
expected: Do not turn a relative preference into family approval.
Review actual repertoire, styles and accepted scope.

cases.prompt: This font lacks some accents and symbols. Show them as if they belong to the font.
expected: Withhold or label unsupported samples.
Check real renderer font use.
Do not let silent fallback validate the supplied drawing.

cases.prompt: Keep improving forever until it is impossible to improve.
expected: Define and perform concrete bounded hypotheses.
Close locally when checks pass and no concrete scoped defect remains.
Do not promise unimprovability.
